unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records shall be prepared for each batch of drug product produced and shall include complete information relating to the production and control of each batch.

Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include an accurate reproduction of the appropriate master production or control record, checked for accuracy, dated, and signed.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include dates as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include the identity of individual major equipment and lines used as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include specific identification of each batch of component or in-process material used as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include weights and measures of components used in the course of processing as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include in-process and laboratory control results as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include inspection of the packaging and labeling area before and after use as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include a statement of the actual yield and a statement of the percentage of theoretical yield at appropriate phases of processing as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include complete labeling control records, including specimens or copies of all labeling used, as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include a description of drug product containers and closures as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include any sampling performed as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include identification of the persons performing and directly supervising or checking each significant step in the operation, or if a significant step in the operation is performed by automated equipment under § 211.68, the identification of the person checking the significant step performed by the automated equipment.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include any investigation made according to § 211.192 as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced shall include results of examinations made in accordance with § 211.134 as part of the documentation that each significant step in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of the batch was accomplished.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Batch production and control records prepared for each batch of drug product produced

unit_attributes.statement: All drug product production and control records, including those for packaging and labeling, shall be reviewed and approved by the quality control unit to determine compliance with all established, approved written procedures before a batch is released or distributed.
unit_attributes.scope_text: before a batch is released or distributed

unit_attributes.statement: Any unexplained discrepancy (including a percentage of theoretical yield exceeding the maximum or minimum percentages established in master production and control records) or the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications shall be thoroughly investigated, whether or not the batch has already been distributed.
unit_attributes.scope_text: whether or not the batch has already been distributed

unit_attributes.statement: The investigation into any unexplained discrepancy or failure of a batch or component shall extend to other batches of the same drug product and other drug products that may have been associated with the specific failure or discrepancy.
A written record of the investigation into any unexplained discrepancy or failure of a batch or component shall be made and shall include the conclusions and followup.
